data.title: Ripple (XRP) and Stellar (XLM) Are Trailing Bitcoin This Month. Which Catches Up First?
data.description: Bitcoin has pulled ahead while two of crypto's top payment coins struggle to keep pace, and the gap between them reveals a telling split in investor confidence, ETF momentum, and price resilience that could determine which coin moves first.
